evidence.observation: Tube pressure rises monotonically through growth, 3.01→3.25 Torr (k=21→25), while Ar flow and T stay at setpoint
Flow steady ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow change
Sensor not installed; inert atmosphere cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (not installed) to distinguish air in-leak from exhaust restriction; a pump-down/flow-step test showing whether pressure tracks flow would discriminate blockage vs leak.
